en.headline: CK Asset pauses sales launch at Yuen Long Montage development
en.dek: The developer confirmed the suspension of marketing for the 327-unit Northern Metropolis project but dismissed speculation that presale consent had been revoked.
body: CK Asset Holdings has suspended sales at its Yuen Long residential project Montage, days before it planned to begin marketing the development’s first homes.

The developer confirmed the suspension to the South China Morning Post but declined to explain the decision, saying only that it reserved the right to pause or commence sales at any time. It dismissed market speculation that the government had revoked the project’s presale consent as baseless.

Earlier this week, a sales executive had indicated that the company planned to release arrangements for at least 66 houses as early as this week, with the sales gallery expected to open the following week. The project comprises 327 units, including 242 apartments and 85 garden houses.

Local media reports suggested the pause may relate to revisions of land grant documents with the government, potentially delaying the launch until December. The project, located in Kam Tin, received presale consent in June and has a key date of December 2027.

zh.headline: 長實暫停元朗萬芎項目銷售安排
zh.dek: 發展商確認暫停這個北部都會區327伙項目的市場推廣，但否認預售同意被撤銷的市場猜測。
body: 長江實業已暫停其元朗住宅項目「萬芎Montage」的銷售活動，距離原定開始推售首批單位只剩數日。
發展商向南華早報確認暫停決定，但拒絕解釋原因，只表示保留隨時暫停或開始銷售的權利。集團否認政府已撤銷項目預售同意的市場猜測，指有關說法毫無根據。
本周早前，銷售主管曾表示計劃本周內公布至少66座洋房的銷售安排，示範單位預計下周開放。項目合共提供327伙，包括242伙分層單位及85座花園洋房。
本地媒體報道指，暫停可能與需要與政府修訂地契文件有關，或延至12月才重新推出。項目位於錦田，今年6月已獲預售同意，關鍵日期為2027年12月。
